mapper.select: INSERT INTO ai_report (campaign_id, report_type, input_json, content, model) VALUES (#{campaignId}, #{reportType}, CAST(#{inputJson} AS jsonb), #{content}, #{model}) RETURNING report_id

SELECT report_id, campaign_id, report_type, CAST(input_json AS text) AS input_json, content, model, created_at FROM ai_report WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND report_type = #{reportType} ORDER BY report_id DESC LIMIT 1
